```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(miloR)

```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
```

```{r}
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% c("6"))
grp_vec <-  srt_sub@meta.data %>% with(setNames(rownames(.), sample.name))
grp_list <- srt_sub@meta.data %>% with(split(rownames(.), sample.name))
data <- GetAssayData(srt_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")
all_cells <- colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
gene_data <- GetAssayData(srt_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "data")["Cd14",] %>% sort
cell_sample <- srt_sub@meta.data %>% with(set_names(sample.name, rownames(.)))
sub_cells <- colnames(srt_sub)
sub_graph <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@neighbors$neighbors_pca.SCT_30@nn.idx[ all_cells %in% sub_cells, ]

gene_ng_avg <- apply(sub_graph, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
  Matrix::rowMeans(data[,cells])
})
colnames(gene_ng_avg) <- all_cells[ all_cells %in% sub_cells]

gene_rnd_avg <- apply(sub_graph, 1, function(ng){
    cells <- all_cells[ng]
    cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
    s <- sample(sub_cells, length(cells))
    Matrix::rowMeans(data[,s])
})
gene_grp_avg <- apply(sub_graph, 1, function(ng){
    cells <- all_cells[ng]
    cells <- cells[cells %in% colnames(data)]
    s <- sample(sub_cells, length(cells))
    mean(cell_sample[s] == "HSC_WT_CD41+")
})

feat <- "Cd14"
enframe(gene_ng_avg[feat,],name = "cell_id") %>% 
  full_join(srt_sub@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id")) %>% 
  bind_rows(data.frame(sample.name = "random",value = gene_rnd_avg[feat,] )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sample.name, value))+
  geom_boxplot()

```

Compute pure neighborhood average

```{r}
gene_ng_pure_avg <- apply(sub_graph, 1, function(ng){
  cells <- all_cells[ng]
  grp <- grp_vec[cells[1]]
  cells <- cells[cells %in% grp_list[[grp]]]
  Matrix::rowMeans(data[,cells])
})
colnames(gene_ng_avg) <- all_cells[ all_cells %in% sub_cells]

feat <- "Cd14"
enframe(gene_ng_pure_avg[feat,],name = "cell_id") %>% 
  full_join(srt_sub@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id")) %>% 
  bind_rows(data.frame(sample.name = "random",value = gene_rnd_avg[feat,] )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sample.name, value))+
  geom_boxplot()

```

Bi-modality testing

```{r}
install.packages("diptest")
install.packages("BimodalIndex")
```

```{r}
feat <- "Cd14"

enframe(gene_ng_avg[feat,],name = "cell_id") %>% 
    full_join(srt_sub@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("cell_id")) %>% 
  with(split(value,sample.name))%>%
  lapply( diptest::dip.test)


sample_list <- split(names(cell_sample), cell_sample)

lapply(sample_list, function(cells){
  BimodalIndex::bimodalIndex(gene_ng_avg[feat,cells,drop = FALSE])

})

```

```{r}
srt_sub <- FindVariableFeatures(srt_sub) %>%
       ScaleData() %>%
       RunPCA() %>%
       FindNeighbors(dims = 1:20) %>%
       FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) %>%
       RunUMAP(dims = 1:20, min.dist = 0.05, n.neighbors = 15)
```
